assessment_objectives.objective: requests for remote management access to embedded technologies are approved by designated personnel before access is enabled.
remote management access to embedded technologies is enabled only for the duration of an approved need and is disabled when the need ends.
persistent ("always on") remote management connections to embedded technologies are eliminated, with remote sessions established on demand and terminated on completion.
remote management of embedded technologies requires strong authentication (e.g., multi-factor authentication).
remote management sessions to embedded technologies are logged and the logs are reviewed at a defined frequency for unapproved or anomalous access.
